S1-landing.head: rig 'jump_peak' at 18.75 kg a leg (axle 1776 N): 182 N m roll and 632 N up at the hip frame's mount plane, plus 10 % of the 1060 N ground force sideways at the contact patch on BOTH legs; the payload's inertia on the tray (80 %) and the belly (20 %)

S1F-collapse.head: rig 'power_off' at 18.75 kg a leg (axle 1929 N): 344 N m roll and 1208 N up at the hip frame's mount plane, plus 10 % of the 1945 N ground force sideways at the contact patch on BOTH legs (the undamped power cut, D39); payload inertia as S1

S1b-one-leg-bound.head: rig 'jump_peak' at 18.75 kg a leg (axle 1776 N): 182 N m roll and 632 N up at the hip frame's mount plane, plus 10 % of the 1060 N ground force sideways at the contact patch on ONE leg, the other cheek clamped: every newton crosses the gap (a bound: in a one-wheel landing the body's inertia takes most of it)

S2-twist.head: one leg's 80 N m roll moment (the HM budget) against the other's

S3-pitch.head: the two motors' 60 N m caps reacted as one 120 N m couple about y, and 600 N fore-aft (the HM budget)

D1-hand-front.head: 300 N down on the deck at the front (a child leaning on it), the turret plate under the riser (D59)

D1-hand-riser.head: 300 N down on the deck at the riser (a child leaning on it), the turret plate under the riser (D59)

D2-turret-fall.head: a 30 g fall of the 2.56 kg head (the turret plan's budget) at 45 deg, its centre 100 mm above the TM face: a tip-over, the turret plate under the riser (D59: SF >= 2.0, the everyday target)

T1-tray.head: what stands on the floor tray at 8.51 g (the body's landing peak from the rig): the compute 1.39 kg on its isolators, the power skid 1.86 kg on its posts, the deck with the lidar and turret 4.56 kg on the deck posts, the DDR-120C; the tray held by its screws
